newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths sees 8-9 pct sales growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths sees 8-9 pct sales growth.

text.p: Grocery retailer Woolworths said it expected sales growth for the group overall to be in the region of eight to nine percent in the 1996/97 financial year, but that sales growth on a store-by-store basis would be around 4.5 percent.

"In terms of revenue much depends on the Christmas trading perod, but we would expect revenue growth in the order of 4.5 percent on a same store or comparable basis in the year to June 1997, but the group as a whole through our continued programme of new store development we would expect to record a sales increase in the order or eight to nine percent," said Woolworths chairman John Iliffe told the annual general meeting.
Woolworths reported sales of A$13.99 billion in the 52 weeks to June 23, 1996 from A$12.79 billion in 1994/95.
